svg.title: Anatomy of one measured spectrum: EleutherAI/pythia-160m, gpt_neox.layers.5.mlp.dense_h_to_4h
svg.desc: Histogram of the 768 squared singular values of a 3072 by 768 matrix on a log scale. A Marchenko-Pastur curve shows an i.i.d. matrix of the same shape and norm for reference. The tail above the median eigenvalue is fitted by a power law with alpha 2.56 and Kolmogorov-Smirnov distance 0.117. A log-log plot of the tail shows the fitted line. A strip below shows alpha for all 50 matrices of the model in depth order.
svg.text: λmin median eigenvalue, the tail starts here
384 eigenvalues at or above the cutoff
C Fitted α for every matrix, input to output
